patch_design_notes.header_name: Per Composio docs the EXACT header name is `x-consumer-api-key` (lowercase, hyphenated). NOT `x-api-key`, NOT `Authorization`, NOT `X-Consumer-API-Key`. The `x-api-key` header is for the LEGACY per-server URL form (mcp.composio.dev/composio/server/{id}/mcp); the unified connect.composio.dev/mcp endpoint uses `x-consumer-api-key`.
patch_design_notes.transport_type: type=http with type:http (Streamable HTTP per CC's MCP-spec — same form as deepwiki, context-mode, cognee, hf-mcp-server). NOT type=sse (legacy).
patch_design_notes.env_interp_pattern: Follows the W317-S7 perplexity precedent + W265 langfuse precedent + W286 P0C cardinal-rule-9 contract: env-interp ${COMPOSIO_API_KEY} in tracked .mcp.json (cardinal-rule-1 trusted-source + cardinal-rule-2 hooks contract), with the REAL API key value held in CLAUDE.local.md (gitignored, per-machine).

notes_for_operator: Composio is a SaaS backend — by wiring this MCP, the runtime sends every meta-tool call to connect.composio.dev. Operator should be comfortable with: (1) Composio's ToS for data-handling; (2) the COMPOSIO_API_KEY granting access to all OAuth apps the operator has authorized; (3) ToS-lock risk if Composio changes pricing or API.

Alternative install-shape (NOT proposed here): /plugin marketplace add ComposioHQ/composio-plugin-cc + /plugin install composio-mcp@composio. This bundles auto-OAuth + skills. Trade-off: pulls in skills/agents into the local runtime (slower spawn + larger preload); the direct .mcp.json HTTP wire is leaner. Operator may prefer the plugin form for full OAuth UX.

LANDSCAPE.md §8.6 quotes a LEGACY URL (mcp.composio.dev/composio/server/{id}/mcp with Authorization Bearer or x-api-key). This is for SINGLE-TOOLKIT MCP servers (custom-configured at dashboard.composio.dev, scoped to specific apps). The proposed connect.composio.dev/mcp form is the UNIFIED Connect gateway covering 1000+ apps in one URL. Operator should pick based on use case; the unified form is recommended for general Claude Code use.
